description: Defines the Scale class which models scaling factors and offsets used for calculations in a tuning or data acquisition context within the RomRaider project.

classes.name: Scale
classes.description: A Java class representing a scaling factor with properties such as name, unit, expression, and min/max values, with methods to access and modify them, as well as equality comparison.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a detailed string representation of the Scale object, including all its properties.

methods.name: getUnit
methods.description: Returns the unit string associated with the scale.

methods.name: setUnit
methods.description: Sets the unit string for the scale.

methods.name: getFormat
methods.description: Retrieves the string format for displaying the scale value.

methods.name: setFormat
methods.description: Sets the string format for displaying the scale value.

methods.name: getExpression
methods.description: Returns the expression used for scaling calculations.

methods.name: setExpression
methods.description: Sets the expression used for scaling calculations.

methods.name: getCoarseIncrement
methods.description: Returns the coarse increment value.

methods.name: setCoarseIncrement
methods.description: Sets the coarse increment value.

methods.name: isReady
methods.description: Checks if the scale is properly configured to be used, based on non-null, valid properties.

methods.name: getByteExpression
methods.description: Returns the byte expression used for encoding the scale.

methods.name: setByteExpression
methods.description: Sets the byte expression used for encoding the scale.

methods.name: getFineIncrement
methods.description: Returns the fine increment value.

methods.name: setFineIncrement
methods.description: Sets the fine increment value.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name of the scale.

methods.name: setName
methods.description: Sets the name of the scale.

methods.name: getMin
methods.description: Returns the minimum value allowed for the scale.

methods.name: setMin
methods.description: Sets the minimum value for the scale.

methods.name: getMax
methods.description: Returns the maximum value allowed for the scale.

methods.name: setMax
methods.description: Sets the maximum value for the scale.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Overrides the default equals method to compare Scale objects based on their properties.
